reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin providing a configurable text translation workspace with file import, streaming model translation, formatting options, local history, and browser-based copy, speech, and download tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供支持多语言、术语表、格式保留、文件导入和本地历史记录的可配置文本翻译工作台。
summaries.en: A configurable DeepSeek Harness text translation workspace with multilingual options, glossaries, formatting preservation, file import, streaming output, and local history.

capabilities: translates user-provided text through the selected dsh model
imports text, Markdown, CSV, JSON, HTML, and XML files up to 2 MB
stores up to 100 translation history items and preferences in browser local storage
uses clipboard operations, browser speech synthesis, and text file downloads
